newsitem.title: USA: EP MedSystems gets Euro catheter approval.
newsitem.headline: EP MedSystems gets Euro catheter approval.

text.p: EP MedSystems Inc said on Tuesday that it received authorization to place the CE Mark on its atrial defibrillation catheters, including its patented ALERT catheter.
EP said it expects to receive the CE Mark on its ALERT Companion device in June, which will allow the company to begin European distribution of the ALERT System in the third quarter of 1997.
The ALERT System includes the catheter and Companion device.
The company also said it expects approval to begin U.S. clinical trials of its ALERT System in this second quarterm of this year.
The trial should be completed by the end of this year, followed by a Pre-Market Approval filing in early 1998, it said.
The ALERT system uses a proprietary catheter to deliver low energy electrical impulses directly to the inside of the heart in order to convert atrial fibrillation to a normal heart rhythm.
